input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Exercising our convenience right triggers early-termination charges of an amount fixed elsewhere (Attachment A / Service Option Attachments) with no cap in the Base Terms, so we are exposed to an open-ended Customer-payable liquidated amount. Redline applies the fallback: a single charge capped at three months' recurring charges for the terminated Services.

input.quote: IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES, PRODUCTS, DATA, APPARATUS AND SOFTWARE "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND
input.rationale: There is a reasonable care and skill warranty for the Services, but no conformance warranty for Materials or Base Components (they are supplied "AS IS") and no stated remedy, and Sections 5.2/5.4 disclaim everything else. That falls short of the fallback (90 days for software with repair/replace/refund). Redline adds a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty with the standard remedy and carves the express warranties out of the disclaimers.
